questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — highest total of 170, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/12.

questions.question: At which ground did Dané van Niekerk record their career-best innings (100, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground, against Badgers on 2024/12/15.
